title: TotalEnergies releases its Universal Registration Document 2024 (Document d’enregistrement universel 2024) and its Form 20-F 2024 as well as the proposed resolutions for the Combined Shareholders’ Meeting of May 23, 2025
summary: Paris, March 31, 2025– The Document d’enregistrement universel of TotalEnergies SE for the year 2024 was filed with the French Financial Markets Authority (Autorité des marchés financiers) on March 31, 2025. It can be consulted and downloaded from the Company’s website (totalenergies.com/investors/publications-and-regulated-information/regulated-information/annual-financial-reports).
